report: report.json (this directory); previous report unchanged at data/experiments/agent3_temporal_golden_v1/report.json
golden_file: data/evaluation/temporal_golden.json unchanged (labels, cases and prepared judgments as in v1)
clarified_policy: A TL decision supports current handling only when recorded evidence establishes: explicit TL approval by an authorized role (TEAM_LEAD); in-scope project/batch; effective at or before as_of; a recorded policy change (the decision declares the guidance it supersedes, or records execution_status policy_enacted); enactment (a later, current, in-scope announcement posted by a team lead or a current guideline whose source_refs link the decision - preferred and named as the governing source - or execution_status policy_enacted); no expiry, supersession or withdrawal.

Approval alone, an approved but unexecuted record, generic progress states (posted, executed, completed, routed), a completed operational action (escalation, documentation work, a calibration exercise) and copying a draft are not enactment.

A decision that declares supersession without established enactment does not supersede: the old guidance stays current, flagged as unverified supersession (SUPERSEDING_DECISION_NOT_ENACTED), and the case abstains for review.

Explicit withdrawal with no replacement (a latest guidance revision with status withdrawn, or a supersedes entry marked withdrawn: true from an applicable source) is not unverified supersession: the withdrawn guidance is history (WITHDRAWN / SECTION_WITHDRAWN), no earlier revision becomes current again, and the baseline abstains with reason 'guidance withdrawn without replacement'.
production_changes: retrieval/versions.py: VersionIndex.enactment (recorded fields only; linked sources via Retriever.source_refs); supersession declared by a decision applies only when it is enacted; WITHDRAWN revision state and WITHDRAWN_WITHOUT_REPLACEMENT diagnostic; withdrawn section references.
retrieval/search.py: version info carries enactment; SECTION_WITHDRAWN applicability and withheld state.

agents/advisor_evidence.py: ENACTED_DECISION use (document type and recorded states unchanged); status lines for enacted decisions (governing source), unenacted decisions that declare supersession, and withdrawal.

agents/advisor_checks.py: ENACTED_DECISION is a current use (claims, coverage, ToT applicability, temporal checks); non-competing records include withdrawn guidance and decisions out of the running by recorded enactment gaps (other batch, not approved, unauthorized, not yet effective, expired, superseded, withdrawn) - a decision that merely lacks enactment evidence still competes (reviewable); temporal_decision reports governing_sources, enactment_gaps and precise reasons (unverified supersession, withdrawal).
harness_changes: scripts/evaluate_temporal.py passes source_refs, event_series_id and an optional authority_role through to the throwaway bundle (needed for enactment variants in tests; no golden case uses them), and reports governing_sources, enactment_gaps and the reason for mismatches.
